title: How To Turn Visa Gift Card into Cash Using Paypal or Venmo | Transfer GiftCard Money to Bank Account
description: Hey fellow investors! In this video I show you how to turn those pesky visa gift cards you get as gifts or from surveys into cash into your checking account. The whole process only takes a few minutes and is super simple to follow! This way you don't have to worry about trying to spend the whole balance of the giftcard or worry about losing the gift card in the meantime. This is a super simple tutorial and you can do the same process with paypal (as shown in the video) or with venmo.   If you don't want to create a second account as talked in the video, you can also add the gift as a payment method to your account and then send the balance to a friend and have the friend refund the money. From there you can just send/deposit it into your bank account then. The money can be in your account instantly (with paypal and paying another 1% fee) or within 1 to 2 days. This method is the lowest fees and fastest method to turn the gift card into cash.  Let me know if you get lost anywhere throughout the process!   Paypal link: https://www.paypal.com/in/home Second option ~ Venmo link: http://www.venmo.com/Kevin-Scanlan22
